name: Hannah Devens

aka: Hannah Covert (Find a Grave index, per FamilySearch)

birth.place: Walpack, Sussex Co., New Jersey (Dutch Reformed Church)

bioAdditions: Hannah's baptism is indexed from the Walpack Dutch Reformed Church, Sussex County, New Jersey: born 1 June, baptized 13 August 1787, daughter of Leonard (Leendert) Devens or Davids (S1). The family moved to Plymouth, Luzerne County: FamilySearch gives her sister Jane (later Mrs Nathaniel Johnson, d. 1885) a Plymouth birth in 1793 (S2); Leonard, Benjamin and Joseph Devens were heads of households in Plymouth in 1820 (S3); Stephen Devens and Leonard Devens are named among the settlers 'northeast of the village' about 1815 (S4); Leonard Devens's will was registered in 1839 (Luzerne Will Book B p.20) (S5); and Elizabeth, 'wife of Leonard' Devens, died 30 Jan 1858 aged 80 and was buried in the Shupp Cemetery, Larksville (S6) - probably a second wife, being only nine years older than Hannah. The name Stephen among the Devens men is suggestive given her son Stephen J. Scott. FamilySearch links her to a Find a Grave index entry as 'Hannah Devens Covert', implying a second marriage to a Covert after Daniel Scott's death c.1811; several Covert households lived in Plymouth Twp in 1840 (S7). None of this yet proves that she was Stephen Scott's mother; Leonard's will is the obvious test.

relationships.evidence: FamilySearch tree only; Devens family resident in Plymouth Twp 1790s-1850s
